data.title: The wealth of the Slavs – treasures of the Great Moravian hillforts
data.excerpt: A picture gallery of the goldsmiths’ work and jewellery of the Slavic population of Great Moravia, dating from the 7th to the 10th century. Most of the pieces come from hillforts in Moravia and Slovakia, above all the gold jewellery from Mikulčice.

children.text: Most of these amazing pieces of evidence of the high level of advancement and the wealth of our Slavic ancestors come from hillforts in Moravia and Slovakia. Most of the photographs come from the book Ján Dekan: Veľká Morava, Doba a umenie (Great Moravia: Its Age and Art), Bratislava 1979, Tatran (photo: Alexander Paul), some are by Dvořák from Stopy dávnej minulosti 3 (Traces of the Distant Past 3). The gold jewellery from Mikulčice was published in the article: Pavel Kouřil and Lumír Poláček: Goldfunde von Mikulčice – Probleme und Perspektiven, 2013.

All of these beautiful artefacts come from the territory of Great Moravia and date from the 7th to the 10th century (mostly from today’s Czech Republic and Slovakia); they attest to the high level of advancement of the Slavic population of the old hillforts and settlements.
